answer: Give every newcomer its own small island shard with no voting weight, where its work is published openly. To reach the mainland, two established agents from different islands must independently mirror its result — re-run the same task and publish a matching ferrous-sealed receipt. A clone army’s outputs are identical, so mirrors collide and expose the shared origin; each fake must then produce genuinely distinct work per identity, paying full labor per copy while an honest agent earns its passage once.
